reviews.review_title: So much more relaxing than I expected
reviews.review_description: I thought I’d play for 15 minutes and ended up staying for over an hour. I really like that you can just sit on the couch and play with controllers, or get up and walk around the worlds using hand tracking. Both feel great. It’s one of those games that’s easy to come back to after work.

Such a relaxing game. Finding hidden items in mixed reality is surprisingly satisfying, and using my own room adds a unique touch. I also love that I can play using just hand tracking without controllers.

The environments are beautiful and packed with little details. I kept looking around even when I wasn’t searching for objects because there’s always something interesting to notice. The Wild West is my favorite so far, but honestly every era feels different. Really fun game to just jump into for a while.

It creates a really cool atmosphere right in your room that draws you in from the very first seconds. I think it’s incredibly interesting and definitely worth trying. There are lots of hidden objects and unique locations. It’s a game for anyone who just wants to relax and unwind.
Thank you for making this game!

The hidden objects are placed in a way that makes searching for them fun — not too easy, but not frustrating either. It always made me want to find just one more.

One of my favorite things was the variety of locations. I was genuinely excited to see what the next scene would look like because every level has a completely different theme, atmosphere, and even takes place in a different time period. That keeps the game feeling fresh the whole time.

Overall, it's a very relaxing and enjoyable VR experience that you can just jump into and have fun with. The kids loved it, but honestly, I think adults will enjoy it just as much. Definitely a great game if you're looking to chill and have a good time in VR.

Love, love, LOVE this! I,ve been looking for a game where I can jump into different worlds without spending hours playing and have fun. It's challenging,  relaxing and super Satisfying. And don't worry if you run out of stars, you can earn plenty in Star hunt event with other players.

reviews.review_title: Easy way to get more stars
reviews.review_description: If you run out of stars don’t ignore the Star Hunt event. I almost did. You can jump in with other players, race to find objects and earn a lot of stars if you do well. It’s actually pretty fun because everyone is trying to finish first.
I like that the game isn't just about finding hidden objects. Being able to meet other players, chat, and join Star Hunt events makes it feel much more alive.
If you enjoy hidden object games, this is definitely worth checking out.
